S7CommPlus fixes for S7-1500 CPUs with firmware V4.x (tested on PLCSIM Advanced V8, FW S4.1).
**Upgrade if you use S7CommPlus with an S7-1500 FW V4.x**, in particular with TLS.

## Highlights

- **Symbolic access over TLS works on FW V4.x.** Before this release, symbol resolution, `dbs`
  and `browse` failed on these CPUs with `Explore returned 0xa201be00017eff79`, so tags such as
  `"DB".member` could not be read over TLS. The request format now matches what the firmware
  expects.
- **A clear error when the CPU requires TLS.** Some CPUs accept only TLS sessions (FW V4.x, or
  "Only allow secure PG/PC and HMI communication" in TIA Portal). Without TLS, the connection
  failed with the unclear error "CreateObject returned no session id". It now says: "the PLC
  refused the session without TLS … enable TLS on the endpoint".
- **Standard DBs are no longer reported as optimized on FW V4.x.** `dbs` showed every DB as
  `optimized: true`, and the symbols of a standard DB got no absolute address. Risk: none for
  reads and writes by symbol; only the reported DB type and the symbol-to-address mapping were
  wrong. Older firmware (S7-1500 below V4, S7-1200 FW V3) gives the same result as before.

## Upgrade notes

- With an S7-1500 FW V4.x that requires TLS, turn on TLS on the endpoint.
- No change to the nodes, their settings or S7comm.
